relationship: A student's set memberships determine the corresponding notation and whether union, intersection or complement rules select that student.

learnerLoop.action: Change student memberships and choose the recipient rule.
learnerLoop.modelChange: Each student's membership representation and selected-recipient preview update.
learnerLoop.evidence: The membership display, live notation and recipient count show the exact set operation.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Change a membership to test a boundary case or revise the rule before sending.

invariants: Each student's set-membership truth is represented consistently in the diagram, notation and operation results.
Union, intersection and complement select regions according to their set definitions.
safeAdaptations: Vary labels, students and target set operations.
Use alternative visual or interactive representations while keeping membership facts, notation and operation results consistent.
nonGoals: Treating overlapping and exclusive regions as the same membership.
